knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Section 6.2 and table 1: outdoor stabilised pools use cyanuric acid at 30 to 50 mg/L.
Section 6.2, section 7.2 and the table 3 note: the regulations prohibit stabilisers at indoor public pools and spas.
Section 6.2 and table 8: above 50 mg/L disinfection slows, and the stabiliser level is brought down by dilution because it is not removed by chlorine.

practicalCriteria: For a supplied outdoor public pool, tests cyanuric acid and records whether it is inside the 30 to 50 mg/L range.
Refuses to add stabiliser to a supplied indoor pool scenario and escalates to the operator.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Stabiliser test record for the assessed pool
Assessor observation of the refusal and escalation
stopWorkCriteria: Proposal to add stabiliser to an indoor public pool or spa: refuse and escalate.
Stabiliser above 50 mg/L: do not add product; escalate for dilution.
